market_definition: The Global Ethylene Oxide Derivatives Market covers chemicals made from ethylene oxide: BY PRODUCT TYPE: Ethoxylates (Alcohol, Fatty Acid, Fatty Amine, Alkylphenol and Other Ethoxylates), Ethylene Glycols, Polyethylene Glycols (PEGs), Polyether Polyols, Ethylene Oxide Sterilants, Polyethylene Oxide (PEO), Ethylene Carbonate, Other Ethylene Oxide Derivatives. BY FUNCTION: Surfactants, Solvents, Chemical Intermediates, Humectants, Emulsifiers, Dispersants, Wetting Agents, Defoamers, Plasticizers, Corrosion Inhibitors, Gas Treatment Chemicals, Antifreeze & Coolants, Sterilizing Agents, Others. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Home Care, Personal Care & Cosmetics, Pharmaceuticals & Healthcare, Agrochemicals, Paints Coatings & Inks, Oil & Gas, Textile & Leather, Automotive, Construction, Chemical Manufacturing, Packaging, Food & Beverage Processing, Electronics, Pulp & Paper, Water Treatment, Others. BY FEEDSTOCK SOURCE: Ethylene-Based, Bio-Ethylene Based. BY SALES CHANNEL: Direct Sales, Indirect Sales. BY REGION: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, Middle East, Africa. Customer industries (from the customer-intelligence file): home care (Hindustan Unilever, P&G, Henkel, Colgate-Palmolive, Reckitt), personal care and cosmetics (L'Oreal, Estee Lauder, Shiseido, Beiersdorf), agrochemicals (Syngenta, Bayer, Corteva, FMC, UPL), paints, coatings and inks (PPG, AkzoNobel, Asian Paints, Jotun, Sun Chemical), oil and gas (SLB, Halliburton, Baker Hughes), textile and leather, automotive, construction (Sika, Mapei, Saint-Gobain, Pidilite), chemical manufacturing (Ecolab, Solenis), packaging, food and beverage processing, pharmaceuticals and healthcare, electronics, pulp and paper and water treatment (Kemira, Kurita, Veolia). COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR (indirect sales channel): a chemical distributor, trader, importer or stockist that buys ethylene oxide derivatives from their producers and resells them to the customer industries above. EXCLUDED companies: EO derivative producers and their own sales subsidiaries, the end-user customers themselves, and companies not selling EO derivatives.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
